lead_raw_text:
The structure of V4Co4Pd16 (reduced formula VCoPd4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and V centers each coordinated by eight Pd neighbors, while Pd centers adopt two distinct 11-vertex coordination environments. A three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spans all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Pd-centered 11-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Co- and Pd-centered polyhedra.
